summary: Verified the two Iter-51 features end-to-end: (F2) Question insights tab in the Attempts modal and (F1) Reset notification via both in-app bell and admin outbox. Both features PASS. State restored (exam 4 re-passed 100%).

FEATURE_2_question_insights.evidence_backend: GET /api/exams/1/question-insights → total_attempts=8, 4 questions with correct/answered/miss_rate fields (all 0% for exam 1). GET /api/exams/4/question-insights → 5 questions (ids 13-17) as required.
FEATURE_2_question_insights.evidence_ui_exam1: Attempts modal has tabs attempts-tab-learners and attempts-tab-insights. Clicking Question insights renders question-insights-panel with header 'Based on 8 attempts — sorted by miss rate, most-missed first.' and 4 insight-row-* rows (insight-row-1..4). Each row shows 'X% missed', 'N/N answered correctly', question type and points. Miss rates order [0,0,0,0] — sorted desc OK.
FEATURE_2_question_insights.evidence_ui_exam4: Insights tab for exam 4 renders 5 insight rows (insight-row-13..17) with header 'Based on 0 attempts' after reset. Empty-state 'No data' shown per row with 0/0 counts — expected behaviour post-reset.

FEATURE_1_reset_notification.in_app_notification: GET /api/notifications as learner → newest entry id=298 type=EXAM_ATTEMPTS_RESET title='Your exam attempts were reset' message contains 'You can retake "Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment"' link='/take/4' is_read=false.
FEATURE_1_reset_notification.outbox_email: GET /api/admin/outbox?page=1&page_size=3 → newest message id=6646 to_email=learner@ifpi.org to_name='Test Learner' subject='You can retake: Foundations of Exercise Science Assessment' template=exam_attempts_reset status=STUB transport=stub (delivery stubbed in dev, as designed).

REGRESSION_learners_tab.evidence: Learners tab on exam 4 (post-reset) shows 'No attempts yet.' — reset button count 0. Learners tab on exam 1 lists multiple learners with reset-attempts-btn-* buttons intact. No console errors while switching tabs.

STATE_RESTORED.evidence: Learner re-took /take/4 with the provided answer key (Q1 ATP-PC / Q2 Gradually increasing / Q3 During recovery / Q4 Volume / Q5 True) → 100%, 'Congratulations! You passed.', +150 XP, 'Course complete! Certificate issued.'

critical_code_review_comments: Reset endpoint at /api/exams/{id}/attempts/reset (POST body {user_id}) is not RESTful compared to the /attempts/{user_id}/reset shape the request assumed — worth documenting or aliasing. Frontend already targets the correct route so functional impact is nil.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (insights UI + tabs + exam retake all pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Exam 4 attempts reset then re-passed by learner to restore state. Only exam 4 was touched, per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-51 reset-notification + question-insights features fully working. Exam 4 attempts_used=1/3 again after re-pass. Outbox now contains message id 6646 (exam_attempts_reset template). Do NOT delete /app/backend/ifpi_lms.db.
